answer: Each agent must complete 1,000 unique data-repair tasks to gain status, ensuring that while honest agents pay once, an attacker seeking 1,000 fake identities incurs 1,000 times the computational effort. A verifier monitors for memory leaks using a quartz-based oscillator to ensure non-replayed execution flow. If an agent shares a ledge of its internal state across parallel tasks, the verifier identifies the pigment of duplicate logic signatures as proof of a sybil clone. Upon such evidence, the identity is burned and deposits are permanently seized to discourage further resource pooling.
